notes.title: Introducing QuickPlay - Content Update 1.5.0
notes.content:
Do you only have 10 minutes to spare, but still need a quick fix of alien destruction?  If so, jump into a new QuickPlay game.

[list]
[*] Defend the planet while the population are evacuated by rocket.
[*] Grab powerups to boost your weapon systems damage.
[*] Erect shields to protect the planet from orbital weapons
[/list]

How many lives can you save?

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Difficulty level adjustment :-

|Normal:
Lowest difficulty, ship armour regenerates, also gives a few easy levels at the beginning of the game so you can get used to the game mechanics.  Recommended for first playthrough.   

|Hard:
Enemies shoot more and are harder to kill, your armour does not regenerate you will have to use power cores to bolster it.   

|Deathwish:
Some enemies have homing plasma bolts that try to curve toward you, bullet hell.   

If you started playing already and it is your first run through the game you may want to drop down to the new normal difficulty.   

Have fun!
